snippet.title: FYOF: I Swear I Didn't Download That - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
We're Fahrettin's House, a two-person independent game studio developing FYOF: I Swear I Didn't Download That.

Take control of an armed Recycle Bin and fight endless waves of hostile files and folders in this chaotic roguelite bullet heaven game!

Support our small indie studio by adding FYOF to your Steam wishlist! Release Date: 4 Mar 2027.

🗑️ FYOF: I Swear I Didn't Download That
